name: Pfizer, Inc.
research_rationale: Research still weakens the buy case: 24 Nov press reinforces dividend-cover and valuation scepticism plus drug-pricing politics, while Japan/Canada LNP suits stay unresolved versus Starna and oncology headlines.

weekly_updates.summary:
Q3 2026 results (3 Nov 8-K/10-Q): $16.6bn revenue, $0.56 diluted EPS; nine-month GAAP earnings still down sharply on impairments and legal charges.  
Starna Therapeutics exclusive licensing (up to $2.6bn, announced 18 Nov) adds CAR-T autoimmune programmes; press debate continues on dividend cover and patent cliff.

Arbutus and Genevant expanded lipid-nanoparticle patent actions in Japan (injunction and damages on mRNA COVID vaccines) and broadened remedies in Canada, per 23 Nov press.  
No new company filings since 19 Nov; commentary on dividend cover, valuation and pipeline deals is unchanged.

No material change. The 24 Nov news batch has no Pfizer-specific items since the 23 Nov refresh. Japan/Canada lipid-nanoparticle litigation and dividend or patent-cliff commentary remain as last recorded; no new company filings in the supplied sources.

Later 24 Nov press revisits the Starna in vivo CAR-T licence and oncology growth narrative; no new SEC filings since the 3 Nov Q3 packet.  
Commentary adds dividend-trap and above-fair-value warnings plus post-election US drug-pricing politics.  
Japan/Canada lipid-nanoparticle actions remain as last recorded; outcomes still unknown in the file set.
